reader.requirement: END-REWRITE ends the REWRITE statement's scope, so 'REWRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1] END-REWRITE' is a delimited-scope statement accepted wherever an imperative statement is (inside IF/ELSE, a NOT AT END phrase, before a period), and an END-REWRITE that matches no REWRITE is refused. The 1985 sequential format has no INVALID KEY, FROM literal, lock, RETRY or FILE phrase, so those must be refused at 85.

edition-consulted.switches: gates the FILE file-name-1 alternative and the RECORD word (2002 constructs): refused at 85

reader.edition-search: the grammar's END_REWRITE? is unconditional; the version gates on the statement are the visitors above plus the record-lock and RETRY construct gates (COBOL0900). None of them touches END-REWRITE itself, which is a 1985 word.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for END-REWRITE's scope; yes for the phrases inside the scope: FROM literal, LOCK, RETRY and FILE are refused at 85 and accepted later
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1m8_rewrite_format_85 uses END-REWRITE on an INDEXED file, which is the Indexed I-O module's REWRITE, not the Sequential one; not exercised: END-REWRITE on a sequential file inside IF/ELSE and NOT AT END, a stray or doubled END-REWRITE, the later-edition phrases at 85

reader.notes: The rewriteStatement rule ends with END_REWRITE?, and the error strategy reports a terminator with no open REWRITE. The scope probes and the refusal of every later-edition phrase at 85 all match.

refuter.evidence: The 1985 sequential REWRITE (§1985:VII.4.5.2) has no conditional phrase, so END-REWRITE only closes an imperative REWRITE. Probes beyond the reader's (refute-1985-025/src/rw9b.cob, --std 85): REWRITE R1, END-REWRITE (comma separator before the terminator) inside an inline PERFORM 2 TIMES -> 00 twice; REWRITE R1 FROM W END-REWRITE inside EVALUATE WHEN, the DISPLAY after it stays in the WHEN; REWRITE R1 END-REWRITE inside the AT END imperative of a READ of another file -> 43 (the last F statement was a REWRITE, GR2) and control continues after END-READ; the file holds LOOP01, LOOP01, FROMWS. The reader's probes already cover the stray/doubled terminator and the later-edition phrases refused at 85. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.5.4 GR9; OK §1985:VII.4.5.4 GR2.
